coverage_note: Casablanca and Tarraco have accepted BOE regulator-record API values. Strict refreshes still fail closed until accepted cited factors cover every current CORES oil field.

factors.measurement_basis: BOE national crude price order for crude from the Casablanca exploitation, stated at wellhead
factors.source_title: BOE Núm. 167, Orden de 25 de mayo de 1977: Casablanca and Tarraco crude sales prices
factors.evidence_note: The BOE order fixes the sales price for crude from the Casablanca exploitation and states 33° API with 0.2% sulfur at the wellhead.

factors.measurement_basis: BOE national crude price order for crude from the Tarraco concession, stated at wellhead
factors.source_title: BOE Núm. 167, Orden de 25 de mayo de 1977: Casablanca and Tarraco crude sales prices
factors.evidence_note: The BOE order fixes the sales price for crude from the Tarraco concession and states 35° API with 0.2% sulfur at the wellhead.
